jobs.title: Sr Revenue Management Consultant - Pricing
jobs.description:
Department:
Revenue Management & Pricing

Our Company Promise

We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description:
The Senior Revenue Management Consultant supports the Revenue Management Team by providing strategic guidance and expert insight that shape pricing and revenue optimization decisions across Southwest’s network. They’ll Lead high‑priority Commercial initiatives, develop and implement Revenue Management strategies, and ensure revenue opportunities are maximized through the effective alignment of People, assets, and network resources. They’ll partner across Commercial and enterprise Teams to influence key business decisions, communicate strategic recommendations, and ensure the Revenue Management perspective is represented in long‑term planning and cross‑functional initiatives. The Senior Revenue Management Consultant leverages deep Revenue Management expertise, strong analytical and communication skills, and thought leadership to drive business performance and support Southwest’s competitive position in the marketplace.

Additional Details
- The culture of Southwest Airlines means we value the camaraderie, collaboration, and innovation that occurs when we come together and interact face-to-face at our vibrant Corporate Campus. Due to the nature of this role, you would be required to work from our Dallas, TX headquarters facility during business hours.

- U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.

Responsibilities
- Interact with executives to gather and analyze information, formulate and test hypothesis, develop and communicate recommendations, risks, issues, and influence business decisions
- Research, develop, and build business cases for complex executive strategic, operational, technological, compliance, and other business opportunities and initiatives
- Lead independent financial analysis efforts on multiple topics and act as the point person for executive updates, requests for information, questions, or special projects by performing deep-dive analytics across multiple topics
- Define and manage strategic projects in support of ad hoc companywide initiatives, while managing multiple complexities and on-time deliverables
- Identify opportunities to design new and refine existing analyses and processes to improve the Revenue Management team's productivity, accuracy, and efficiency over time
- Work effectively across teams, listen well, consider diverse opinions, contribute fully to team’s success, drive consensus, and keep Commercials partners informed of developments on initiatives
- Drive and influence business decisions through a comprehensive understanding of operational, financial, environmental, and/or industry drivers and variables
- Structure complex and ambiguous problems and act to holistically solve them
- Support cross-functional initiatives and lead meetings with key stakeholders at all levels
- Develop well-written presentations that convey key information, including business cases, roadmaps and other materials that support alignment efforts
- Manage cross-functional initiatives and lead meetings with key stakeholders at all levels
- May perform other job duties as directed by Employee’s Leaders

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
- Expert knowledge of macro and microeconomic principles and practices
- Expert knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, production methods, and coordination of people and resources
- Knowledge of implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making
- Skilled in collecting, organizing, visualizing, and assimilating data by turning raw data into meaningful information using data-oriented and visualization software
- Knowledge of principles and methods for moving people by air and alternatives, including the relative costs and benefits
- Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems
- Ability to identify complex problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions
- Strong communication skills and ability to interact with employees at all levels in the organization
- Ability to communicate actions and plans to peers and leaders with supporting reasoning
- Ability to adjust plans based on changing business trends, changing capabilities or changing priorities
- Skilled in Microsoft Office including Excel/spreadsheets and writing SQL

Education
- Required: High School Diploma or GED

Experience
- Expert level experience, expansive and far-reaching knowledge in: - Revenue Management principles and practices
- Understanding of the commercial make up of Southwest Airlines or airline industry and how each department works together to drive success
- Leading complex cross-functional initiatives and aligning stakeholders at all levels
- Presenting to Senior Executives
- High level analytical problem solving
- SQL and Relational databases (Teradata, Oracle, Access, etc.)

- Preferred: Airline Revenue Management or pricing experience
- Preferred: Proficiency with Tableau, and/or Alteryx
- Preferred: Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders
- Preferred: Ability to work in a dynamic, time-sensitive operational environment requiring evening and weekend support

Licensing/Certification
- N/A

Physical Abilities
- Ability to perform work duties from [limited space work station/desk/office area] for extended periods of time
- Ability to communicate and interact with others in the English language to meet the demands of the job
- Ability to use a computer and other office productivity tools with sufficient speed and accuracy to meet the demands of the job

Other Qualifications
- Must maintain a well-groomed appearance per Company appearance standards as described in established guidelines
- Must be a U.S. citizen or have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986
- Must be at least 18 years of age
- Must be able to comply with Company attendance standards as described in established guidelines

Pay & Benefits:
- Competitive market salary from $132,200 per year to $146,900 per year* depending on qualifications and experience. For eligible Leadership and individual contributor roles, additional bonus opportunities are available and awarded at the discretion of the company.

Benefits you’ll love:
- Fly for free, as a privilege, on any open seat on all Southwest flights (your eligible dependents too)
- Southwest will help fund your Retirement Savings Plan with Company contributions up to 9.3% of your eligible earnings**
- Potential for annual ProfitSharing contribution in the Southwest Retirement Savings Plan- when Southwest profits, you profit***
- Competitive health insurance for you and your eligible dependents (including pets)
- Southwest offers health plan coverage options that start from the very first day of employment. You will have 30 days to select and enroll in your health plan with coverage retroactively available to your first day of employment.
- Explore more Benefits you’ll love: https://careers.southwestair.com/benefits

*Pay amount does not guarantee employment for any particular period of time.
**401(k) match contributions are subject to Retirement Savings Plan vesting schedule and applicable IRS limits

jobs.title: Network Strategy Consultant - Network Planning
jobs.description:
Department:
Network Planning

Our Company Promise

We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Job Description:
The Network Strategy Consultant supports the Network Strategy Team by evaluating opportunities and developing strategies that shape the future of Southwest’s route network. They’ll analyze market trends, network performance, and growth opportunities to develop business cases and recommendations for airports, cities, and future domestic and international service. They’ll partner across Network Planning, Commercial and Operational Teams, and Airport Affairs to assess risks, identify opportunities, and support strategic decision‑making. The Network Strategy Consultant leverages strong analytical, communication, and problem‑solving skills to influence network investments, support long‑term growth, and enhance Southwest’s competitive position.

Additional Details
- The culture of Southwest Airlines means we value the camaraderie, collaboration, and innovation that occurs when we come together and interact face-to-face at our vibrant Corporate Campus. Due to the nature of this role, you would be required to work from our Dallas, TX headquarters facility during business hours.

- U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.

Responsibilities
- Support analysis regarding Southwest's network in order to create network strategies influencing the direction of the Southwest network 1.5-15 years in the future
- Assist in the development of strategic and tactical domestic and international commercial plans to enhance the Southwest network
- Assist in maintaining the Network Portfolio and recommends changes to Senior Leadership
- Assist in completing the 3 year and long-term Network Plans (Work Plan)
- Assist in domestic and international new city evaluations
- Assist in performing high level forecasting for new cities as well as overall large scale network changes

- Knowledge of principles and methods for moving people or goods by air, rail, sea, or road, including the relative costs and benefits
- Ability to understand the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making
- Ability to collect, organize, visualize and assimilate data including turning raw data into meaningful information using data-oriented programming languages and visualization software
- Ability to understand and apply information to contribute to the organizations strategic plan
- Ability to come up with a number of ideas about a topic (the number of ideas is important, not their quality, correctness, or creativity)
- Ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events)
- Ability to come up with unusual or clever ideas about a given topic or situation, or to develop creative ways to solve a problem

Education
- Required: High School Diploma or GED

Experience
- Advanced level experience, expansive and far-reaching knowledge in: - Analyzing airline performance in a strategic/commercial planning/ operational planning organization (e.g. Revenue Management, Network Planning, Ops Planning Data Science, Strategic Planning, Financial Planning & Analysis, etc.)

- Must be a U.S. citizen or have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986
- Must be at least 18 years of age
- Must be able to comply with Company attendance standards as described in established guidelines

Pay & Benefits
